company.name: Basket Technologies
company.shortDescription: Basket is an online grocery platform that offers on-demand delivery services for retailers and consumers in Jordan.
company.description: Basket is an app that provides local residents with an online buying experience. Customers can choose goods and merchandise from their preferred merchants, and it will deliver them in as little as an hour to their door. A quick delivery service that delivers goods in 10 minutes has been introduced. They intend to shortly enter the meal delivery business. It has established itself region's fastest-growing e-commerce business by branching out from only groceries to a range of other categories and serving a client base that is expanding daily.

productsAndServices.description: An online platform enabling users in Jordan to order groceries from local stores for on-demand delivery.
